![Overview](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/IWS/BH_NU_BANNER1.webp)

Immersed With Shaders is a fully client side modpack available on NeoForge & Fabric, with the best Performance & FPS you can get on minecraft, also with Quality of Life mods, shaders and enhanced vanilla soundscapes, improved visuals and ambience with no need for Optifine!

[Click Here](https://discord.gg/Ky9JCDAseb) To Join My Discord

![Features](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/IWS/BH_NU_BANNER2.webp)

- ✅Vanilla Server Compatible
- ✅Built In Shaders
- ✅Fully Client Side
- ✅Supports All PC's
- ✅High FPS Boost & Performance
- ✅Many Visual Improvements
- ✅Better HUD
- ✅NeoForge & Fabric

LOTS MORE!

![Shader Customization](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/IWS/BH_NU_BANNER4.webp)

To enable shaders, go to pause menu > Video Settings > Shader Packs > Select the shader that's there and click apply. Toggle Shaders button available too in controls.

I own none of these mods or shaders, all credit goes to the mod authors, shader authors and resourcepack authors.
